title: Content Fuzzing for Escaping Information Cocoons on Social Media
reasoning: The paper presents a framework (CONTENTFUZZ) to modify social media posts to escape information cocoons by changing their machine-classified stance labels. While the experiments include sensitive topics like 'Atheism', 'Feminism', and 'Abortion' for testing stance evasion, the research focuses on the technical methodology of confidence-guided fuzzing and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
